name: Caddy
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Caddy is a fast, modern web server. The egg serves a static website from the public folder: upload your files there, and change the Caddyfile for anything more.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash # Caddy: downloads Caddy from its GitHub releases, checked against # GitHub's SHA-256, and sets up a static website in the public folder. # The website's files and the Caddyfile are never touched once there. set -euo pipefail cd /mnt/server # Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is # small), removed when the script ends. work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work" trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "Caddy has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;; esac version="${VERSION:-latest}" [ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}" # gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached. tag=$(gh-release tag caddyserver/caddy "$version") || exit 1 if [ -x caddy ] && [ "$(cat .caddy-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then echo "Caddy $tag is already installed." else echo "Downloading Caddy $tag." gh-release download caddyserver/caddy "$tag" "caddy_${tag#v}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" $work/caddy.tar.gz tar -xzf $work/caddy.tar.gz -C $work caddy install -m 0755 $work/caddy caddy.new mv -f caddy.new caddy echo "$tag" > .caddy-version fi if [ ! -f Caddyfile ]; then cat > Caddyfile <<'CADDY' # Caddy's settings: https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile # Caddy listens on the server's port ({$SERVER_PORT}) and serves the files # in the public folder. Restart the server after changing this file. { admin off log { format console } } :{$SERVER_PORT} { root * public encode file_server } CADDY fi if [ ! -d public ]; then mkdir -p public cat > public/index.html <<'HTML' It works

It works

Upload your website to the public folder to replace this page.

HTML fi echo "Installed Caddy $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Caddy version to install, such as 2.11.9, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
